title: Tim Taylor visits Charles Hall
summary: Charles Hall's wife tells of Tim Taylor visits Charles Hall, about unspecified at Charles Hall's home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He came here because he found out about Charles

plain: The wife of a man named Charles Hall says that a man called Tim Taylor once came to their home. She tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, saying Taylor came because "he found out about Charles". She doesn't say what Taylor wanted, but she tells it as an early sign that someone with outside interest had taken notice of her husband.
